t: Polyester hybrid mortar specifically for fixings in masonry and non-cracked concrete with a variety of masonry blocks. Suitable for fixing fire escapes, handrails or canopies. Processed with the system components Fischer threaded rod FIS A, Fischer internal threaded rod FIS E together with the Fischer injection anchor sleeves, indoors and outside. It is possible to reuse cartridges already opened by simply changing the static mixer, saving time and money during installation.
